visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman is sitting in the driver's seat of a car at night, wearing a grey ruffled top and a silver metal watch. She holds a small makeup applicator and applies a liquid product to the bridge of her nose and under her eyes, then uses a pink teardrop-shaped sponge to blend it into her skin. (2) She opens a small clear eyeshadow palette containing multiple nude shades and uses her index finger to apply a shimmering pigment to her eyelids. She then takes a small pink tube and applies product to her cheeks, blending it out with the same pink sponge while checking her reflection in the camera. (3) She uses a black eyelash curler to press her lashes upwards and then applies mascara from a wand. She continues to touch up her base makeup with the sponge, looking closely at her eyes and face. (4) She holds a white electric hair styling iron and carefully curls the ends of her dark, shoulder-length hair to create a soft, inward curve. She looks directly into the lens, using it as a mirror while manipulating her hair. (5) The woman holds up a pair of large white pearl earrings and carefully attaches them to her ears, looking slightly to the side to ensure they are positioned correctly. (6) She completes her transformation, leaning her head on her left hand and smiling at the camera with a finished makeup and hair look. The car interior is dark with red seats visible in the background.
